_comment: CAUSE CLASSIFICATION for every page the machine ledger records as NOT_PASS.
docs/admin-certification-ledger.json records OBSERVATIONS ONLY and deliberately
does not decide whether a failure is a deliberate security control or a real
defect. That decision needs per-page evidence and is recorded HERE, by a human,
with the observation that supports it.
RULE: a page may only appear here with an `evidence` field describing a real
measurement. 'BLOCKED' is not a weaker PASS and must never be assigned to make
a count look complete. Resolution for every security-class entry is real
authenticated-session verification, NOT a code change and NOT dismissing the
Measured 2026-08-26 at 390px with admin+superAdmin claims stubbed. For each
drawer failure two questions were asked: is a control topmost at the burger,
and does the drawer move on a direct click? Overlay present + mechanism working
= blocked by design. Nothing was dismissed, removed, or clicked through.
STATES: PASS / BLOCKED / UNPROVEN / LEGACY / NOT RUN. These are deliberately
distinct so that a legacy surface, an environment limitation and a working
security control are never collapsed into a single red bucket. UNPROVEN is
not a weaker BLOCKED, and BLOCKED is not a weaker PASS.

admin.html.evidence: body{visibility:hidden} set at admin.html:6389, restored only at 6394/6399 on successful unlock. The burger inherits hidden, so elementFromPoint returns HTML. Drawer mechanism verified working (-300->0).
admin.html.note: Distinct mechanism from the z-100010 overlays: the whole body is blanked, not covered.

merchant-pipeline.html.evidence: DIV#mp-gate topmost at burger centre, z=100010; drawer -300->0.

superadmin.html.blocker: #saGate, ES-module getAuth() unreachable by the compat stub
superadmin.html.evidence: DIV#saGate topmost, z=100010; drawer -300->0. Separately, #saShell computes display:none for the ENTIRE run, so the 3/7 measures shared chrome only and certifies nothing about this page's own layout.
superadmin.html.note: LEGACY surface. Excluded from the 50-page certification count.

uat-center.html.blocker: real firebase.js overwrites the stub; the shared guard redirects to login
uat-center.html.evidence: Lands on login.html?next=%2Fuat-center.html with no shell header. The 0/7 measured the LOGIN page, so it says nothing about uat-center's layout. The preserved ?next= is correct denial behaviour.
uat-center.html.note: Recorded as a harness limitation, NOT dressed up as a security control.

_states.PASS: Runtime evidence proves the acceptance criteria at all 7 widths.
_states.BLOCKED: A legitimate security or auth gate prevents certification. The control is working as designed; resolution is a real authenticated session, NEVER dismissing it.
_states.UNPROVEN: The harness or environment cannot establish the result. This does NOT classify the page as broken — it means no valid evidence exists yet.
_states.LEGACY: A reachable legacy surface outside the canonical certification population. Reported, but excluded from the certification COUNT.
_states.NOT RUN: No valid certification evidence exists — the page was never exercised.
